## What this dashboard shows

- The dashboard is a proof-of-concept for Wipro's multi-ERP financial consolidation on Snowflake, showing how 5 ERPs (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, Tally Prime, and a second SAP system) land in one group journal and feed consolidated reporting, forecasts and AI analytics.
- The demo processes **4,214,121 journal lines** across **11 entities** from **5 source ERPs**, with **0 unmapped lines**, using a mix of live SAP BDC data (Company 1) and simulated data for the other ERPs in their real source shapes.
- It demonstrates Snowflake's differentiators: zero-copy SAP BDC integration, one platform for SAP and non-SAP, dynamic tables for consolidation, AI/ML on group numbers, and Horizon Catalog governance applying to both dashboards and AI agents.

## What to report

- The proof-of-concept shows a single data foundation pattern for Wipro's 34 ERPs (40% SAP, 60% non-SAP), with Company 1 running on real SAP BDC data via the zero-copy connector and four simulated ERP lanes converging in one governed group journal with full chart-of-accounts mapping (**0 unmapped accounts**).
- Consolidation is declarative: dynamic tables maintain CoA mapping, FX translation and intercompany eliminations automatically, with entities + eliminations reconciling to group (visible in CFO Cockpit / Close & Consolidation).
- AI and analytics (Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agent, ML forecasts, CFO commentary, Ask CoCo) all run on the same consolidated group numbers and definitions as the C-suite reports, through one semantic view over the group model.
- Horizon Catalog policies are enforced in the query engine, so the same RBAC, masking (CSN-tagged PII masked by default) and row-access controls apply automatically to dashboards, analysts and AI agents; **DATA_ORIGIN** on every journal row supports lineage and quality checks are live.

## Watch out for

- **Data caveat**: Companies 2–5 are simulated data in the real source shapes; only Company 1 is real SAP BDC data, so board-ready validation of non-SAP lanes (Oracle, D365, Tally) and end-to-end consolidation accuracy should be confirmed before go-live.
- The demo is scoped at 5 ERPs and 11 entities; **"34-ERP sizing is a separate conversation"** – ask what infrastructure, governance and incremental ingestion costs look like at full Wipro scale (34 ERPs across many geographies).
- Several documented production options are not running live in this demo: row-level access per company, column-level lineage, Trust Center, Openflow connectors for Oracle/D365 (the non-SAP lanes are simulated), and publish-back to SAP BDC – confirm timelines, licensing (e.g. Oracle XStream 12/36-month embedded licence) and build effort with the Snowflake account team.
- **SAP ECC coverage**: the notes state "Datasphere Business Content covers S/4HANA, not ECC; ECC options are SAP-side and to be confirmed with SAP and the account team" – if Wipro's SAP estate includes ECC systems, clarify the migration or custom replication path before committing to architecture.
